# AdditiveTopology_Embedding

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of embedding small-world network graphs directly into 3D-printed polymer substrates, creating physical NoC layouts that mirror optimized logical topologies. Bridges the gap between theoretical topology optimization and physical implementation, enabling practical small-world NoC designs.
